extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern GREAT Term 2 is a regular premium, non-participating term life plan designed to provide coverage for death and terminal illness with level premiums throughout the policy term. The document states it is available with add-on critical illness options, including “Complete Living Care Rider 2”, which covers critical illness across early, intermediate, and late stages; it also states a “late stage critical illness rider” option for those who want only later-stage coverage. For early or intermediate stage critical illness under the named rider arrangement, the brochure specifies an accelerated lump-sum payout of up to S$350,000 per claim (subject to the rider’s sum assured). A key flexibility feature is the Conversion Privilege: it can be exercised once (full or partial), with conversion not later than the policy anniversary when the life assured’s next birthday is 70, and without further health assessments—provided the new policy’s basic sum assured does not exceed GREAT Term 2’s basic sum assured. The policy also references options for TPD and accident riders and premium waiver riders (details not fully shown).
quality_notes: Brochure content is partially corrupted/garbled around the rider premium/payout illustration lines; no reliable rider benefit limits beyond the S$350,000 early/intermediate critical illness statement are clearly extractable.

Key operational details for base death/terminal illness and other optional riders (exact payout amounts, waiting periods, coverage term length, eligibility/underwriting) are not explicitly stated in the provided text.

policies.quick_summary: A regular premium, non-participating term life plan covering death and terminal illness with level premiums, customizable via named critical illness and TPD rider add-ons and conversion to a cash value life policy (once, up to the policy anniversary when next birthday is 70). Covers early/intermediate critical illness via Complete Living Care Rider 2 with accelerated lump-sum up to S$350,000 per claim (subject to rider sum assured). No cash value is stated if the policy ends or terminates prematurely; SDIC protection is referenced as “up to specified limits.” IP/wording is promotional and terms depend on the policy contract.
coverage_scope: critical illness (via Complete Living Care Rider 2 / Living Care Rider 2 arrangement)
total and permanent disability (via TPD Benefit Rider 2)
policies.eligibility_notes: The brochure states that “All ages specified refer to age next birthday.” It also states the conversion privilege cut-off ties to the life assured’s next birthday being 70.
policy_termination_events: The document states that “the policy terminates” with respect to TPD Benefit Rider 2, but the exact base-policy termination events for GREAT Term 2 are not detailed in the provided text.
important_caveats: The Conversion Privilege can only be exercised once (full or partial) and not later than the policy anniversary on which the life assured’s next birthday is 70 years old; conversion also requires the new policy’s basic sum assured not to exceed GREAT Term 2’s basic sum assured.
For Complete Living Care Rider 2, premiums are stated to be not guaranteed and may be adjusted based on future experience.
The brochure states that this product has no savings/investment feature and therefore has “no cash value if the policy ends or is terminated prematurely.”
Figures are subject to rounding in the illustration; promotion ends 31 December 2026 (T&Cs apply).

source_evidence.quote: GREAT Term 2 was created with this in mind. This regular premium, non-participating term plan provides customisable coverage to support you and your family’s needs.

Designed to safeguard your family’s financial security, our term plan provides coverage for death and terminal illness at a low cost. With level premiums throughout the policy term, it helps you keep protection in place while managing everyday financial responsibilities with confidence.
You have the option to seamlessly convert  your term plan and eligible rider(s) to a life policy with cash value, with no further health assessments required.
The Conversion Privilege can only be exercised once, be it a full or partial conversion, and not later than the policy anniversary on which the life assured’s next birthday is 70 years old.

The above is for general information only. It is not a contract of insurance or a recommendation to buy an insurance product or
service.
